article.title: Quiz: guess the idiom's meaning
article.description: Quiz format: 'What does "spill the beans" mean? a) Cook dinner  b) Reveal a secret  c) Make a mistake  d) Waste money' Answer: b) Reveal a secret. Teaching point: this idiom is commonly used informally when someone accidentally or deliberately shares confidential information.
article.content: Quiz format: 'What does "spill the beans" mean? a) Cook dinner  b) Reveal a secret  c) Make a mistake  d) Waste money' Answer: b) Reveal a secret. Teaching point: this idiom is commonly used informally when someone accidentally or deliberately shares confidential information.

generated.caption:
Oops! Did you accidentally reveal a secret? 🤫 That's exactly what "spill the beans" means!

This informal idiom is used when someone shares confidential information, either on purpose or by accident. For example: "Please don't spill the beans about my promotion yet!"

Save this idiom for later and follow @englishvault for daily English tips!
generated.script: Spill the beans! Iska matlab khana banana nahi hota, pata hai? Ye ek bahut common idiom hai jiska literal meaning mat lena. Iska asli matlab hai 'to reveal a secret'. Basically, jab koi accidentally ya deliberately koi confidential information ya secret share kar deta hai, tab hum use karte hain 'spill the beans'. Toh ab next time jab koi bole 'spill the beans', toh aapko pata hoga ki baat secret reveal karne ki ho rahi hai, na ki khana banane ki. Ab aapko pata hai na, it means 'reveal a secret'! Ye tip pata thi? Comment mein batao! Aur The English Vault ko follow karo!

slides.body: The idiom 'spill the beans' is an informal phrase meaning to reveal a secret or confidential information. This often happens either accidentally or deliberately, when details meant to be kept private are shared. For example, if someone accidentally revealed the surprise party plans, they 'spilled the beans'. So, next time someone shares information they shouldn't have, you can say they 'spilled the beans'!
